All money figures are in Pakistani rupees (PKR), from the After Sales FY 2026-27 workbook. Year to date and Annual cover only months with achieved figures; months not yet reported are not counted as zero.

Income = cash labour + warranty labour + warranty parts. Annual = achieved so far against the full-year target (12 monthly targets), judged against target pace: the share of the year's target that falls in the months reported so far. 3D parts are illustrative models, not to scale.
